Name: Beneath You
Author: Trapyy
Description:
[size=5][b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Trapyy/mods]My Other Mods[/url][/b][/size]
If you like the mod and want to support my work, you can do so on my [color=#ff7700][url=https://ko-fi.com/trapyy]Ko-Fi[/url][/color]!


[size=6][b]Overview[/b][/size]

In vanilla Stardew Valley, your farmer can interact with all eight surrounding tiles of the player, but the tile directly beneath your feet is a blind spot.

[b]Beneath You[/b] removes that blind spot. Hover your cursor over the tile you are standing on to till soil, break flooring and optionally place solid items under yourself and automatically step aside.


[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Target the Tile Beneath Your Feet:[/b] Hover over your own standing tile to use your [b]Hoe[/b], [b]Watering Can[/b], [b]Pickaxe[/b], and [b]Axe[/b] directly on that tile.[/*]
[*][b]Charged Tool AoE From Your Feet:[/b] Start a charged Copper+ Hoe or Watering Can while hovering your own tile and the line or rectangle starts directly beneath you instead of leaving an unwatered or untilled gap.[/*]
[*][b]Accurate Tool Hit Marker:[/b] The red tool hit indicator highlights your standing tile when hovered, while keeping vanilla directional behavior whenever your cursor is elsewhere.[/*]
[*][b]Optional Solid Placement & Smart Player Push:[/b] Enable [b]Allow Solid Placement Under Player[/b] in the config to place chests, machines, sprinklers, fences, solid furniture, fruit/tea saplings, and trellis seeds on your standing tile and smoothly slide onto an open adjacent tile.[/*]
[*][b]No Getting Trapped:[/b] If every adjacent tile around you is blocked, solid placement on your tile is prevented (the placement preview shows red and your item is not consumed).[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Requirements and Installation[/b][/size]

Install the following mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] - version 4.0.0 or newer.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] - optional, for changing settings in-game.[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Download [b]Beneath You[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]BeneathYou[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Solid Placement & Smart Push (Optional)[/b][/size]

By default, solid placement under the player is [b]disabled[/b] so only tools and scythes target your standing tile. You can turn on [b]Allow Solid Placement Under Player[/b] at any time in [b]config.json[/b] or through Generic Mod Config Menu.

When enabled:
[list]
[*][b]Place & Step Aside:[/b] Placing a chest, machine, sprinkler, fence, trellis crop, sapling, or piece of solid furniture on your tile automatically pushes you onto the best open adjacent tile.[/*]
[*][b]Natural Row Building:[/b] Choose how the push direction is prioritized, follow your held movement key first, step backward so you can place a row while backing up, step forward, or only push in your facing direction.[/*]
[*][b]Smooth Slide or Instant Snap:[/b] Choose between a short, smooth slide or an instant snap to the adjacent tile.[/*]
[*][b]Face What You Placed:[/b] Optionally turn to face the newly placed machine or chest so you can load or open it immediately.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Settings and Compatibility[/b][/size]

You can configure all options in [b]config.json[/b] or in-game using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]:

[list]
[*][b]Enable Mod:[/b] Master toggle for Beneath You (default: [b]true[/b]).[/*]
[*][b]Allow Solid Placement Under Player:[/b] Allow placing solid objects, furniture, saplings, and trellis seeds on your standing tile with smart player push (default: [b]false[/b]).[/*]
[*][b]Preferred Push Direction:[/b] [b]Held Movement, Then Step Back[/b] (default), [b]Step Back First[/b], [b]Step Forward First[/b], or [b]Facing Direction Only[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Allow Diagonal Push:[/b] Allow pushing to an open diagonal tile if all four cardinal tiles are blocked (default: [b]false[/b]).[/*]
[*][b]Push Movement Style:[/b] [b]Smooth Slide[/b] (default) or [b]Instant Snap[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Face Placed Item After Push:[/b] Turn the farmer to face the newly placed item after being pushed (default: [b]true[/b]).[/*]
[/list]
